tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: What the Antevo Executive connector exposes. No account required.

tools.name: get_executive_brief
tools.description: The Antevo Executive Brief — today's editorial read on markets and world events: the hero takeaway, the regime, the themes that matter, key risks and a market snapshot. Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) to retrieve the brief as it was published on a past date. scope: 'retail' or 'institutional'. The full brie

tools.name: list_executive_notes
tools.description: The archive of past Executive Briefs, newest first — each with its date, title, subtitle and hero line: what has been covered, the date of a story, and how a theme developed over time.

tools.name: get_executive_note
tools.description: One dated Executive Brief in full (YYYY-MM-DD) — the permanent record of what was published that day, for questions such as 'what did the brief say about X back then?'.

tools.name: get_executive_desk
tools.description: The longer-form desk read for today — analysis and research notes.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Where markets stand right now — indices, FX, commodities, crypto.

tools.name: get_indices
tools.description: Major indices with recent history — use days_back (1..365, default 30) to see how markets have moved over a period.

tools.name: get_world_events
tools.description: Geopolitical events over a look-back window (days_back 1..90, default 7) — conflict, chokepoints, sanctions and related signals. The public cut. Pass layers to narrow — waterways, armed_conflicts, hotspots, regulatory, cyber, sanctions — comma-separated. All six together run large and two of them tr

tools.name: get_risk_radar
tools.description: The risk radar — what the Antevo Executive Brief judges could go wrong from here, each with its trend, impact, probability and why it matters, plus the regime it sits in and the indicators that would confirm or kill it. Each risk filed in the desk's register also carries its stable risk_id, its them

tools.name: track_risk_evolution
tools.description: Every risk radar the brief published over recent weeks, in one call — each dated board with its regime and its risks, oldest first: which risks are new, which have been carried for weeks, which dropped off, and how their trend, impact and probability moved. The brief rewords a risk from day to day;

tools.name: get_catalysts
tools.description: The forward calendar — dated events the Executive Brief is watching (data prints, decisions, deadlines), each with the signal to read from it and its category. Use days_ahead (1..90, default 14) to set the horizon. Answers 'what's coming up that could move things?'

tools.name: search_macro_indicators
tools.description: Find a macro-economic series by name or country — CPI, policy and market interest rates, mortgage rates, equity indices, house and residential, real and commercial property prices, industrial production, commodities, currencies and effective exchange rates, credit-to-GDP gaps, current accounts, rese

tools.name: get_forecasts
tools.description: Official economic forecasts for a country or region from the IMF World Economic Outlook and the OECD Economic Outlook: GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, current account, government balance and debt by default; also, by `indicator`, core inflation, short and long interest rates, GDP in US dollars

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: What the Antevo desk writes on beyond the daily brief — shipping, aviation, yachts, energy, infrastructure, real estate, commodities, geopolitics, AI and technology, energy transition, demographics, generational wealth, succession planning, art. Each with the date of its most recent note.

tools.name: get_macro_series
tools.description: One macro series by ticker, newest first, with the date of its most recent observation stated on the response. Series are quarterly or monthly levels and they lag — the newest point is a quarter or month end, never today. Optional since/until (YYYY-MM-DD) narrow the window.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: One coverage area's note in full — for example real-assets-shipping or real-assets-aviation. scope 'retail' (default) or 'institutional'; the institutional read is longer and assumes more. Optional as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) for a past edition, newest otherwise.

tools.name: get_strategy_radar_setup
tools.description: Set up Strategy Radar for a company: everything a company's own assistant needs to match Antevo's daily business board of risks and opportunities to that company's strategy. tools.name: get_business_board
